regional.t: Borders with Iraq and Syria - Avoid all travel
regional.lead: Avoid all travel to within 5 km of the borders with Iraq and Syria, with the exception of the tourist site Umm Qais, due to the threat of terrorism, cross-border violence and crime.

regional.t: Northeastern Jordan, east of Ruwaished - Avoid all travel
regional.lead: Avoid all travel to all areas east of the city of Ruwaished in northeastern Jordan, including Highway 10 leading to Iraq past Ruwaished, due to military activity and the lack of emergency facilities.
